notes.title: Drops Hotfix Confirmation
notes.notes:
With a lot of backend stuff that needed to be sorted out we can now confirm that drops are working correctly.
[b]Please download the update and restart your game for the fix to work and for some to receive their duck reward after a shortened delay.[/b]

This is our first Steam game, yet we already received a lot of positive feedback.
Thank you for understanding and see you in the pond,
[b]DUCKS Team (Comfy Studios)![/b]

notes.title: DUCKS Launch Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hi!
We encountered a bug that prevented some players from receiving the right amount of ducks for their playtime. With today's update we believe [b]we found and solved the issue[/b].
Now everyone should be getting the right amount of ducks and some people will experience a [u]tremendous boost to their drops[/u].

See you in the pond,
[b]DUCKS Team (Comfy Studios)![/b]

notes.title: DUCKS GLOBAL RELEASE
notes.notes:
Long awaited [b]DUCKS[/b] is finally out!
[b]Hop in the game now for a chance to receive a Launch only duck![/b]
[i]This event will last for three days only![/i]

We have a lot of updates and features already in the works. Those features include:
- [b]class system[/b] - different classes will boost your duck drops in different ways
- [b]crafting system[/b] - craft items to boost your progress and drops
- [b]leveling system[/b] - level through 3 classes to unlock new items and ways to boost your progression, quality and quantity of items dropped

We are [u]VERY[/u] excited to finally release our game and can't wait to work on it further!

See you in the pond,
[b]DUCKS Team (Comfy Studios)![/b]
